newsitem.title: UK: BP raising UK Foinaven capacity ahead of start-up.
newsitem.headline: BP raising UK Foinaven capacity ahead of start-up.

text.p: Production capacity at Britain's new Foinaven oilfield development in the Atlantic is being increased by 25,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 120,000 bpd, operator British Petroleum Co Plc said.

Output capacity for the first phase of production would be boosted by modifications to processing plant aboard Foinaven's floating production and storage vessel Petrojarl, BP said in a staff newsletter.
"Moves to match process facilities with expected well output are underway," the newsletter said.

First production from Foinaven is not expected until late in the first quarter of 1997 after the discovery of faults in a subsea manifold pushed back the original start-up date from June of this year.
The Petrojarl modifications are expected to take place in January and February, the newsletter said.
